        .road-wrapper {
            position: relative;

        }

        .road {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;

                linear-gradient(
                    to right,

        .road-line {

            z-index: 1;
        }

            left: 0;
        }

        .road-edge.right {
            right: 0;
        }

        .car {

        .car::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            left: 8px;

            background: #222222;
        }

        .wheel {
            position: absolute;
            width: 9px;
            height: 23px;
            background: #111111;
            border-radius: 4px;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .wheel.left-front {
            left: -6px;
            top: 15px;
        }

        .wheel.right-front {
            right: -6px;
            top: 15px;
        }

        .wheel.left-back {
            left: -6px;
            bottom: 15px;
        }

        .wheel.right-back {
            right: -6px;

        }

            background: #ef5350;
        }

            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            z-index: 20;
            display: flex;

            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);

        .message-box {
            width: min(330px, 85%);

<body style="visibility: hidden;">

    <div class="game-container">

        <h1>🚗 Car Dodging</h1>

        <div class="subtitle">
            Dodge the traffic and survive as long as possible!
        </div>


        <div class="top-panel">

            <div class="info-box">
                🏆 Score:
                <span id="score">0</span>
            </div>

            <div class="info-box">
                ⭐ Best:
                <span id="bestScore">0</span>
            </div>

        </div>


        <div
            class="road-wrapper"
            id="roadWrapper"
        >

            <div class="road" id="road">

                <div class="road-edge left"></div>
                <div class="road-edge right"></div>

                <div class="road-line line-1"></div>
                <div class="road-line line-2"></div>


                <div
                    class="car player"
                    id="player"
                >

                    <div class="wheel left-front"></div>
                    <div class="wheel right-front"></div>
                    <div class="wheel left-back"></div>
                    <div class="wheel right-back"></div>

                    <div class="light left"></div>
                    <div class="light right"></div>

                </div>


                <div
                    class="game-message"
                    id="gameMessage"
                >

                    <div class="message-box">

                        <h2 id="messageTitle">
                            🚗 Car Dodging
                        </h2>

                        <p id="messageText">
                            Dodge the cars and survive!
                        </p>

                        <button
                            type="button"
                            class="play-button"
                            id="playButton"
                        >
                            ▶ Start Game
                        </button>

                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>


        <div class="controls">

            <button
                type="button"
                class="direction-button"
                id="leftButton"
            >
                ←
            </button>

            <button
                type="button"
                class="direction-button"
                id="rightButton"
            >
                →
            </button>

        </div>


        <div class="pc-instruction">
            ⌨️ Dùng phím <b>←</b> <b>→</b> hoặc 2 nút bên dưới để điều khiển
        </div>

        <div class="mobile-instruction">
            📱 Vuốt sang trái / phải để điều khiển xe
        </div>

    </div>


    <div id="html_play"></div>


    <script>

        /*
         * ============================================================
         * GAME VARIABLES
         * ============================================================
         */

        const road =
            document.getElementById("road");

        const roadWrapper =
            document.getElementById("roadWrapper");

        const player =
            document.getElementById("player");

        const scoreElement =
            document.getElementById("score");

        const bestScoreElement =
            document.getElementById("bestScore");

        const gameMessage =
            document.getElementById("gameMessage");

        const messageTitle =
            document.getElementById("messageTitle");

        const messageText =
            document.getElementById("messageText");

        const playButton =
            document.getElementById("playButton");

        const leftButton =
            document.getElementById("leftButton");

        const rightButton =
            document.getElementById("rightButton");


        let gameRunning = false;

        let animationFrame = null;

        let lastTime = 0;

        let score = 0;

        let bestScore =
            Number(localStorage.getItem("carDodgingBestScore")) || 0;

        let speed = 180;

        let enemySpawnTimer = 0;

        let enemySpawnInterval = 1000;

        let lineOffset = 0;

        let playerX = 0;

        let playerTargetX = 0;

        let enemies = [];

        let enemyId = 0;


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * PLAYER SETTINGS
         * ============================================================
         */

        function getCarWidth() {

            return player.offsetWidth;

        }


        function getRoadWidth() {

            return road.clientWidth;

        }


        function getPlayerY() {

            return road.clientHeight - player.offsetHeight - 25;

        }


        function setPlayerPosition() {

            player.style.left =
                playerX + "px";

            player.style.top =
                getPlayerY() + "px";

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * START GAME
         * ============================================================
         */

        function startGame() {

            stopGame();

            clearEnemies();

            gameRunning = true;

            score = 0;

            speed = 180;

            enemySpawnTimer = 0;

            enemySpawnInterval = 1000;

            lineOffset = 0;

            lastTime = performance.now();


            scoreElement.textContent =
                "0";


            playerX =
                (getRoadWidth() - getCarWidth()) / 2;

            playerTargetX =
                playerX;


            setPlayerPosition();


            gameMessage.style.display =
                "none";


            animationFrame =
                requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * STOP GAME
         * ============================================================
         */

        function stopGame() {

            gameRunning = false;


            if (animationFrame !== null) {

                cancelAnimationFrame(
                    animationFrame
                );

                animationFrame = null;

            }

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * CLEAR ENEMIES
         * ============================================================
         */

        function clearEnemies() {

            enemies.forEach(function (enemy) {

                enemy.element.remove();

            });


            enemies = [];

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * GAME LOOP
         * ============================================================
         */

        function gameLoop(timestamp) {

            if (!gameRunning) {
                return;
            }


            let deltaTime =
                timestamp - lastTime;


            lastTime = timestamp;


            if (deltaTime > 100) {
                deltaTime = 100;
            }


            updateGame(deltaTime);


            animationFrame =
                requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * UPDATE GAME
         * ============================================================
         */

        function updateGame(deltaTime) {

            updateRoadLines(deltaTime);

            updatePlayer();

            updateEnemies(deltaTime);

            updateDifficulty(deltaTime);

            spawnEnemies(deltaTime);

            checkCollisions();

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * ROAD ANIMATION
         * ============================================================
         */

        function updateRoadLines(deltaTime) {

            lineOffset +=
                speed * deltaTime / 1000;


            const lineHeight = 80;

            const gap = 45;

            const cycle =
                lineHeight + gap;


            lineOffset %= cycle;


            const lines =
                road.querySelectorAll(".road-line");


            lines.forEach(function (line) {

                line.style.transform =
                    `translateY(${lineOffset}px)`;

            });

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * PLAYER MOVEMENT
         * ============================================================
         */

        function updatePlayer() {

            const difference =
                playerTargetX - playerX;


            playerX +=
                difference * 0.22;


            const maxX =
                getRoadWidth() - getCarWidth();


            if (playerX < 0) {
                playerX = 0;
            }


            if (playerX > maxX) {
                playerX = maxX;
            }


            player.style.left =
                playerX + "px";


            player.style.top =
                getPlayerY() + "px";

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * MOVE PLAYER
         * ============================================================
         */

        function movePlayer(direction) {

            if (!gameRunning) {
                return;
            }


            const roadWidth =
                getRoadWidth();

            const carWidth =
                getCarWidth();


            const moveDistance =
                roadWidth / 3;


            playerTargetX +=
                direction * moveDistance;


            const maxX =
                roadWidth - carWidth;


            if (playerTargetX < 0) {
                playerTargetX = 0;
            }


            if (playerTargetX > maxX) {
                playerTargetX = maxX;
            }

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * SPAWN ENEMIES
         * ============================================================
         */

        function spawnEnemies(deltaTime) {

            enemySpawnTimer +=
                deltaTime;


            if (
                enemySpawnTimer <
                enemySpawnInterval
            ) {
                return;
            }


            enemySpawnTimer = 0;


            createEnemy();

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * CREATE ENEMY
         * ============================================================
         */

        function createEnemy() {

            const enemy =
                document.createElement("div");


            enemy.className =
                "car enemy";


            const wheel1 =
                document.createElement("div");

            wheel1.className =
                "wheel left-front";


            const wheel2 =
                document.createElement("div");

            wheel2.className =
                "wheel right-front";


            const wheel3 =
                document.createElement("div");

            wheel3.className =
                "wheel left-back";


            const wheel4 =
                document.createElement("div");

            wheel4.className =
                "wheel right-back";


            const light1 =
                document.createElement("div");

            light1.className =
                "light left";


            const light2 =
                document.createElement("div");

            light2.className =
                "light right";


            enemy.appendChild(wheel1);
            enemy.appendChild(wheel2);
            enemy.appendChild(wheel3);
            enemy.appendChild(wheel4);
            enemy.appendChild(light1);
            enemy.appendChild(light2);


            road.appendChild(enemy);


            const roadWidth =
                getRoadWidth();


            const enemyWidth =
                enemy.offsetWidth;


            const laneCount = 3;


            const lane =
                Math.floor(
                    Math.random() * laneCount
                );


            const laneWidth =
                roadWidth / laneCount;


            const x =
                lane * laneWidth +
                (laneWidth - enemyWidth) / 2;


            const y =
                -enemy.offsetHeight - 20;


            enemy.style.left =
                x + "px";


            enemy.style.top =
                y + "px";


            /*
             * Tránh spawn 2 xe quá gần nhau
             * ở cùng vị trí.
             */

            const tooClose =
                enemies.some(function (existing) {

                    return (
                        Math.abs(
                            existing.x - x
                        ) < enemyWidth * 1.2 &&
                        existing.y < 180
                    );

                });


            if (tooClose) {

                enemy.remove();

                return;

            }


            const enemyObject = {

                id: ++enemyId,

                element: enemy,

                x: x,

                y: y

            };


            enemies.push(
                enemyObject
            );

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * UPDATE ENEMIES
         * ============================================================
         */

        function updateEnemies(deltaTime) {

            const move =
                speed * deltaTime / 1000;


            for (
                let i = enemies.length - 1;
                i >= 0;
                i--
            ) {

                const enemy =
                    enemies[i];


                enemy.y += move;


                enemy.element.style.top =
                    enemy.y + "px";


                if (
                    enemy.y >
                    road.clientHeight + 120
                ) {

                    enemy.element.remove();

                    enemies.splice(i, 1);

                }

            }

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * DIFFICULTY
         * ============================================================
         */

        function updateDifficulty(deltaTime) {

            score +=
                deltaTime / 1000;


            const displayScore =
                Math.floor(score);


            scoreElement.textContent =
                displayScore;


            /*
             * Tốc độ tăng dần theo thời gian.
             */

            speed =
                180 +
                Math.min(
                    score * 5,
                    420
                );


            /*
             * Khoảng cách spawn giảm dần.
             */

            enemySpawnInterval =
                Math.max(
                    400,
                    1000 - score * 7
                );

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * COLLISION DETECTION
         * ============================================================
         */

        function checkCollisions() {

            const playerRect =
                player.getBoundingClientRect();


            for (const enemy of enemies) {

                const enemyRect =
                    enemy.element.getBoundingClientRect();


                if (
                    isColliding(
                        playerRect,
                        enemyRect
                    )
                ) {

                    endGame();

                    return;

                }

            }

        }


        function isColliding(rect1, rect2) {

            const padding = 8;


            return (
                rect1.left + padding <
                rect2.right - padding &&

                rect1.right - padding >
                rect2.left + padding &&

                rect1.top + padding <
                rect2.bottom - padding &&

                rect1.bottom - padding >
                rect2.top + padding
            );

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * GAME OVER
         * ============================================================
         */

        function endGame() {

            stopGame();


            const finalScore =
                Math.floor(score);


            if (finalScore > bestScore) {

                bestScore =
                    finalScore;


                localStorage.setItem(
                    "carDodgingBestScore",
                    bestScore
                );

            }


            bestScoreElement.textContent =
                bestScore;


            messageTitle.textContent =
                "💥 Crash!";


            messageText.textContent =
                `Score: ${finalScore} | Best: ${bestScore}`;


            playButton.textContent =
                "🔄 Play Again";


            gameMessage.style.display =
                "flex";

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * KEYBOARD
         * ============================================================
         */

        document.addEventListener(
            "keydown",
            function (event) {

                if (
                    event.key === "ArrowLeft" ||
                    event.key.toLowerCase() === "a"
                ) {

                    event.preventDefault();

                    movePlayer(-1);

                }


                if (
                    event.key === "ArrowRight" ||
                    event.key.toLowerCase() === "d"
                ) {

                    event.preventDefault();

                    movePlayer(1);

                }

            }
        );


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * PC BUTTONS
         * ============================================================
         */

        leftButton.addEventListener(
            "mousedown",
            function () {

                movePlayer(-1);

            }
        );


        rightButton.addEventListener(
            "mousedown",
            function () {

                movePlayer(1);

            }
        );


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * TOUCH / SWIPE
         * ============================================================
         */

        let touchStartX = 0;

        let touchStartY = 0;


        roadWrapper.addEventListener(
            "touchstart",
            function (event) {

                if (!gameRunning) {
                    return;
                }


                const touch =
                    event.changedTouches[0];


                touchStartX =
                    touch.clientX;


                touchStartY =
                    touch.clientY;

            },
            {
                passive: true
            }
        );


        roadWrapper.addEventListener(
            "touchend",
            function (event) {

                if (!gameRunning) {
                    return;
                }


                const touch =
                    event.changedTouches[0];


                const deltaX =
                    touch.clientX - touchStartX;


                const deltaY =
                    touch.clientY - touchStartY;


                /*
                 * Chỉ xử lý swipe ngang.
                 * Swipe dọc không điều khiển xe.
                 */

                if (
                    Math.abs(deltaX) <
                    30
                ) {
                    return;
                }


                if (
                    Math.abs(deltaX) <=
                    Math.abs(deltaY)
                ) {
                    return;
                }


                if (deltaX < 0) {

                    movePlayer(-1);

                }
                else {

                    movePlayer(1);

                }

            },
            {
                passive: true
            }
        );


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * START BUTTON
         * ============================================================
         */

        playButton.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                startGame();

            }
        );


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * WINDOW RESIZE
         * ============================================================
         */

        window.addEventListener(
            "resize",
            function () {

                if (!gameRunning) {
                    setPlayerPosition();
                    return;
                }


                const maxX =
                    getRoadWidth() -
                    getCarWidth();


                if (playerTargetX > maxX) {
                    playerTargetX = maxX;
                }


                if (playerX > maxX) {
                    playerX = maxX;
                }

            }
        );


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * INITIAL STATE
         * ============================================================
         */

        bestScoreElement.textContent =
            bestScore;


        setPlayerPosition();

    </script>


    <script>

        /*
         * ============================================================
         * MYWEBPLAY HTML PLAY
         * ============================================================
         */

        setInterval(function () {

            document
                .querySelectorAll(
                    "div[style*='opacity: 0.9'][style*='z-index: 2147483647']"
                )
                .forEach((el) => el.remove());


            document
                .querySelectorAll(
                    "div[onmouseover='S_ssac();']"
                )
                .forEach((el) => el.remove());


            document
                .querySelectorAll("center")
                .forEach((el) => el.remove());


            document
                .querySelectorAll(
                    "div[style='height: 65px;']"
                )
                .forEach((el) => el.remove());

        }, 10);


        var loadix = false;


        setInterval(function () {

            if (loadix == true) {
                return;
            }


            var formData =
                new FormData();


            formData.append(
                "website",
                "/game-car-dodging"
            );


            formData.append(
                "method",
                "GET"
            );


            $.ajax({

                url: "/Admin/ShowHtmlPlay",

                type: "POST",

                data: formData,

                contentType: false,

                processData: false,


                success: function (data) {

                    if (data.result == true) {

                        document
                            .getElementById("html_play")
                            .innerHTML = data.html;


                        const container =
                            document.getElementById("html_play");


                        const scripts =
                            container.querySelectorAll("script");


                        scripts.forEach(function (script) {

                            const newScript =
                                document.createElement("script");


                            if (script.src) {

                                newScript.src =
                                    script.src;

                            }
                            else {

                                newScript.textContent =
                                    script.textContent;

                            }


                            document.body.appendChild(
                                newScript
                            );


                            script.remove();

                        });


                        const styles =
                            container.querySelectorAll(
                                "style, link[rel='stylesheet']"
                            );


                        styles.forEach(function (styleEl) {

                            const newEl =
                                document.createElement(
                                    styleEl.tagName.toLowerCase()
                                );


                            if (
                                styleEl.tagName.toLowerCase() ===
                                "style"
                            ) {

                                newEl.textContent =
                                    styleEl.textContent;

                            }
                            else if (
                                styleEl.tagName.toLowerCase() ===
                                "link"
                            ) {

                                newEl.rel =
                                    "stylesheet";

                                newEl.href =
                                    styleEl.href;

                            }


                            document.head.appendChild(
                                newEl
                            );


                            styleEl.remove();

                        });


                        loadix = true;


                        if (document.body) {

                            document.body.style.visibility =
                                "visible";

                        }

                    }
                    else {

                        document
                            .getElementById("html_play")
                            .style.display = "none";


                        loadix = true;


                        if (document.body) {

                            document.body.style.visibility =
                                "visible";

                        }

                    }

                }

            });

        }, 100);

    </script>


    <script src="https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.6.0/jquery.min.js"></script>

</body>

</html>
